name: @xl0/pi-lovely-ide
description: Connect [Pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi) to your IDE. Pi sees what you have selected in the editor, and you can send it code ranges and diagnostics with a keystroke — no copy-pasting file paths, line numbers, or compiler errors into the prompt.
